title: Valencia · Tribunal de las Aguas
subtitle: Eight elected farmer-judges, meeting every Thursday at the Apostles' Door since 1273. Adjudicates Turia-river water disputes — orally, in 15 minutes, with no written record. UNESCO Intangible Heritage, 2009.
imageAlt: The Tribunal de las Aguas of Valencia in session at the Apostles' Door of Valencia Cathedral. A robed syndic stands center; eight elected judges sit on either side.

callouts.label: ELECTED SYNDIC
callouts.detail: One per acequia, speaks for the community
